dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.context: Dropdown option for top layer height filter pillar visibility.

dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.en: Controls pillar visibility based on whether its top layer is at or below the visible height limit.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.context: Tooltip for Top pillar visibility option.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.de: Steuert die Sichtbarkeit der Säule basierend darauf, ob sich ihre oberste Ebene auf oder unter der sichtbaren Höhengrenze befindet.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.es: Controla la visibilidad del pilar en función de si su capa superior está en el límite de altura visible o por debajo de él.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.it: Controlla la visibilità del pilastro in base al fatto che il suo strato superiore sia pari o inferiore al limite di altezza visibile.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.pt: Controla a visibilidade do pilar com base no fato de sua camada superior estar no limite de altura visível ou abaixo dele.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.ru: Управляет видимостью столба в зависимости от того, находится ли его верхний слой на видимом пределе высоты или ниже него.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.sv: Styr pelarens synlighet baserat på om dess översta skikt är vid eller under den synliga höjdgränsen.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.zh: 根据其顶层是否处于或低于可见高度限制来控制支柱可见性。

dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.context: Dropdown option for off height filter pillar visibility.

dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.en: Hides all pillars whenever any height layer is filtered out.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.context: Tooltip for Off pillar visibility option.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.de: Blendet alle Säulen aus, wenn eine Höhenebene herausgefiltert wird.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.es: Oculta todos los pilares cada vez que se filtra cualquier capa de altura.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.it: Nasconde tutti i pilastri ogni volta che viene filtrato un livello di altezza.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.pt: Oculta todos os pilares sempre que qualquer camada de altura é filtrada.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.ru: Скрывает все столбы всякий раз, когда отфильтровывается какой-либо слой высоты.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.sv: Döljer alla pelare när något höjdlager filtreras bort.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.zh: 每当过滤掉任何高度层时，都会隐藏所有柱子。
